offering_description.value: Develops and sells prescription medicines for opioid use disorder. It supplies monthly injections and sublingual medicines through specialty distributors, pharmacies, and treatment providers.

primary_products.value: Long-acting buprenorphine injections; sublingual buprenorphine and naloxone films; sublingual buprenorphine tablets

customer_segment.value: B2B: Pharmaceutical wholesalers, specialty pharmacies, addiction treatment clinics, and health systems; B2G: Public health systems and correctional health programs

end_markets.value: Addiction treatment; outpatient healthcare; pharmacy; correctional healthcare

revenue_model.value: product sales: Prescription doses sold through pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: Develops drug formulations, sources finished medicines from contract manufacturers, and sells them through pharmaceutical wholesalers and specialty distributors

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with sales in Canada, Europe, and Australia

specialization.value: niche specialist: Opioid use disorder medicines in long-acting injectable and sublingual formulations

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: Specialty pharmaceutical distributors and drug wholesalers supplying clinics and pharmacies; third-party retail: Retail pharmacies dispensing sublingual prescriptions; partners / resellers: Specialty pharmacies coordinating delivery of injectable doses to administering clinicians
distribution_channels.category: distributors / dealers; third-party retail; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Prescription drug approvals and manufacturing oversight by the FDA and overseas regulators, plus DEA controls on buprenorphine distribution

notes: The current commercial status of its opioid overdose reversal nasal spray is uncertain.
